def_en: 1) upon, over, on account of, above, to, against
1a) upon, over, on account of, regarding, concerning, on behalf of
kjv: about, against, concerning, for, (there-) fore, from, in, [idiom] more, of, (there-, up-) on, (in-) to, [phrase] why with.
expl: {above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications}
